pages.title: Luxe & Lush Hair Salon – Professional Hair Services
pages.html:
✨ Luxe & Lush

Luxe & Lush Hair Salon

Professional Hair Services in Portland

Experience luxury hair care with our expert stylists. From cuts and color to styling and treatments, we create looks that make you feel confident and beautiful.

Book Your Appointment

Our Services

Hair Cuts & Styling

Precision cuts tailored to your face shape and hair type. Includes wash, cut, and professional styling.

$65–$95

Hair Coloring

Full color, highlights, balayage, and dimensional color treatments. Consultation included to find your perfect shade.

$85–$180

Keratin Treatments

Smoothing and conditioning treatments that reduce frizz and add shine. Results last 3–4 months.

$120–$200

Blowouts & Upstyles

Professional blowout styling for everyday looks or special events. Bridal and formal updos available.

$50–$90

Deep Conditioning

Intensive moisture treatments for dry, damaged, or curly hair. Leaves your hair soft and revitalized.

$40–$75

Hair Extensions

Seamless extensions for length and volume. Multiple application methods available. Consultation required.

$200–$400

Why Choose Luxe & Lush?

Expert Stylists

Our team has 10+ years of experience and stays current with the latest trends and techniques.

Premium Products

We use only high-quality, salon-grade products to protect and enhance your hair.

Personalized Care

Every client receives a customized consultation to ensure the perfect result for your unique hair.

Welcoming Atmosphere

Our salon is a relaxing, inclusive space where you'll feel pampered from the moment you arrive.

What Our Clients Say

"I've been coming to Luxe & Lush for two years and my hair has never looked better. The team really listens and delivers exactly what you want."

— Sarah M.

"My wedding day hair was absolutely stunning. The stylist made me feel so comfortable and the updo lasted all night. Highly recommend!"

— Jessica R.

"After years of damage from other salons, my hair is finally healthy again. The keratin treatment changed everything for me."

— Marcus T.

Book Your Appointment

Schedule your visit with us and discover the Luxe & Lush difference. Fill out the form below to request your preferred time and service.

Questions? Call us at (503) 555-0142 or email hello@luxelush.com. We'll confirm your appointment within 24 hours.

Luxe & Lush Hair Salon

📍 247 Maple Street, Portland, OR 97214 | 📞 (503) 555-0142

Hours: Tue–Sat 9am–6pm, Sun 10am–4pm | Closed Mondays
